step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays Salary Overflow, a serverless application designed to provide transparency into tech salaries using AWS. Static frontend assets stored in Amazon S3 are delivered to the user's web browser via Amazon CloudFront. When users access the Salary Overflow web interface, authentication is managed by Amazon Cognito. On new user registration, Cognito triggers an AWS Lambda function to insert new user records into an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. For application interactions, the web client communicates with AWS AppSync using GraphQL APIs to query and mutate relational data stored in Aurora. Additionally, user tracking, session, and authentication metrics are logged directly from the frontend web client to Amazon Pinpoint.
